limitations: Controlled OpenAI SDK parse boundary; actual provider mapping, engine, policy and SQLite repository run without network/model/payment.
SQLite proves existing JSON serialization/read mapping; no migration, D1 transaction or production claim.
Real browser component geometry is recorded separately; no claim of model localization accuracy.
